{{ElectionsTN}}
The '''2026 Tennessee gubernatorial election''' is scheduled to take place on November 3, 2026, to elect the [[governor of Tennessee]]. [[Primary elections]] took place on August 6, 2026.<ref>{{Cite web|date=May 9, 2025 |title=2026 State Primary Election Dates |url=https://www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/2026-state-primary-election-dates|website= NCSL |access-date=5 August 2025}}</ref> [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] senator [[Marsha Blackburn]] and [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] city councilor Jerri Green are the nominees for their respective parties. Republican incumbent [[Bill Lee (Tennessee politician)|Bill Lee]] is [[Term limits in the United States|term-limited]] and cannot seek a third consecutive term.

Democrats have not won a statewide election in Tennessee since [[Phil Bredesen]] was re-elected governor in [[2006 Tennessee gubernatorial election|2006]]. Either major party nominee would be the first female governor of Tennessee.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Jarrett |first=Kim |date=2026-08-06 |title=Tennessee poised to have its first female governor |url=https://www.themountaineer.com/news/national/tennessee-poised-to-have-its-first-female-governor/article_a34121c2-26dc-503a-8fac-d4ae12051c66.html |access-date=2026-08-13 |website=The Mountaineer |language=en}}</ref>
